data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then a drafted email with the correct subject and body template), but it splits the client into recipient_email and recipient_name when the true workflow derives both from {client}@example.com. It also adds an ISO code, ends with a vague "send or save" step instead of "Do not send, click Discard", and doesn't name the three tabs or the scroll to GDP growth, which makes it slightly less precise but still buildable.
